findings.summary: After typing 750 in the monthly deposit field, the slider showed 800, so the reader couldn't tell which value the calculation was using.
The 2% inflation assumption is hidden behind a button and isn't shown next to the 'in today's money' result. The reader wants more transparency, but the button works.

Part of the screen jumped sideways when the reader edited the first field (today's amount). It's an annoying layout shift, but it's sideways and in a different field, so it isn't the note that pushes the result cards up and down.
The 15-year cost breakdown bar depends only on a colour legend. The reader had to guess which colour was tax, the biggest part, so they couldn't read a main figure reliably.
The fund box has many jargon tags the reader didn't understand. They're secondary details.
